container.name: filebrowser
container.note: Its first start prints a generated admin password in the logs; change it after signing in. Runs as uid 1000, so it listens on 8080 (FB_PORT) rather than port 80; Flotilla gives both new volumes to 1000:1000. Its files volume starts empty.

summary: Sleek web interface for managing, browsing, uploading, and sharing local server files.
title: File Browser Web Portal
